objs.name: policy
objs.description: Company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level such as code of conduct, travel expenses policy, ICS policy, process and organizational structure.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Regulations and instructions documenting company-wide or locally defined regulations or business process-specific regulations.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Detailed description of specific procedures within a framework, process sequence, and responsible persons to achieve an objective.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Documentation of detailed work steps and procedures such as test instructions that supplement procedural instructions with additional forms and checklists.

objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed artifact in the P&R Management system subject to creation, editing, release, distribution, and archiving.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document automatically released with the main document and subject to versioning and release process of the main document.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: A document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document and can be released or deleted independently.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal to amend a document that does not affect the content or version history of the main document.

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated request created when a document reaches 30 days before validity expiration to determine if the document remains valid.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to declare a released document invalid and withdraw it from circulation when it has no additional validity.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated document and restore its status.

objs.name: author
objs.description: A user with read and write permissions to create and edit documents and all details such as attachments and change proposals.

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: A user with additional personal change rights on a document but no relevance in the release workflow.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: A user who checks the content of a document according to technical and formal aspects and must approve it before release.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: A user responsible for the document and its content who decides whether to distribute it to readers.

objs.name: reader
objs.description: A user who can only view approved documents assigned via distribution list or reader group.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: A user who can translate released content into another language but cannot create new objects independently.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A maintained list of User Groups or persons who receive read authorization and are informed about document releases.

objs.name: document_version
objs.description: A released state of a document with associated metadata, attachments, and signature documentation.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A digital signature applied by workflow participants to document release, review, and approval steps.

objs.name: audit_trail
objs.description: A system-maintained record of all changes, approvals, and document lifecycle events for traceability.

objs.name: pdf_conversion
objs.description: An automatic conversion of a document to PDF format for web display after content saving.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: A user group that retains read access to archived and invalidated documents while other authorizations are revoked.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A group of users with assigned authorizations for reading, authoring, reviewing, or releasing documents.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: A role-specific interface providing users with documents relevant to them based on distribution list membership.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template for creating new documents with standardized metadata and content structure.

objs.name: referenced_document
objs.description: A document that is linked to another document via the references attribute.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: A translated version of a released document that must be reviewed and released before visibility to readers.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: An active confirmation by a user that they have received and viewed a released document.

objs.name: document_status
objs.description: The current state of a document in its lifecycle such as editing, review, released, or archived.

objs.name: document_abbreviation
objs.description: A code assigned to each document type used in document naming such as RL for guidelines.

objs.name: document_metadata
objs.description: Standardized and customer-specific attributes maintained for documents such as scope, version, and status.

objs.name: expiration_date
objs.description: The date calculated as Valid from date plus period of extended validity after which a document validity must be checked.

objs.name: multi_client_system
objs.description: A system configuration where a document can specify visibility across different client environments.

objs.name: client_environment
objs.description: A distinct organizational unit or company instance in a multi-client system with separate document visibility.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Creation of a new information object in the system with selection of document type and optional template.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Modification of a document's content using the integrated editing client and Office components.

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Input and update of standardized and customer-specific document attributes grouped in categories.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assignment of read, write, and role-based permissions to users and user groups for a document.

evts.name: initiate_release_process
evts.description: Start of the workflow-supported 3-step approval process by the author or co-author.

evts.name: author_sign_document
evts.description: Electronic signature by the author in the first workflow step of the release process.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Technical and formal checking of a document by assigned reviewers who must approve it positively.

evts.name: reviewer_sign_document
evts.description: Electronic signature by reviewers confirming approval of the document during the review step.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Final approval and electronic signature by a releaser to distribute the document to readers.

evts.name: releaser_sign_document
evts.description: Electronic signature by the releaser confirming approval and authorization to release the document.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatic publication of a released document making it visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatic conversion of a document to PDF format and display on the web after content saving.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: Automatic creation of a new version when a released document is revised or when specific changes occur.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Marking of an attachment for archiving when it is no longer relevant to a new document version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Submission of a proposed amendment to a document without affecting its content or version history.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Decision to implement a change proposal which creates a new version of the document.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declaration of additional validity for a document in the absence of need for revision.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: System-generated request created when a document is 30 days from expiration requiring validity review.

evts.name: process_validity_extension
evts.description: Workflow-supported check and decision by releaser or author/reviewer/releaser on document validity.

evts.name: override_document
evts.description: Declaration of invalidity and withdrawal of a released document from circulation.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Submission of a request to invalidate a document that has no additional validity.

evts.name: process_override_request
evts.description: Workflow-supported review and approval to declare a document out of force and archive it.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Revocation of all user authorizations except for the archive group with physical deletion after archive period.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Re-validation of a previously invalidated document restoring its original status and permissions.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Submission of a request by Business Admin group to reactivate an archived document.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Automatic notification by email to assigned users and user groups when a new document version is released.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatic request for active confirmation of document receipt by assigned users and user groups upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Workflow-supported active confirmation by a recipient that they have received and reviewed a document.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translation of a released document's content into another language with review and release workflow.

evts.name: translate_review
evts.description: Review and approval of a translated document version to ensure accuracy and quality.

evts.name: translate_release
evts.description: Final approval and release of a translated document version making it visible to authorized readers.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Attachment of a controlled document object to a main document subject to the main document's release process.

evts.name: add_additional_information
evts.description: Attachment of non-critical supplementary information to a document released independently from the main document.

evts.name: view_document
evts.description: Access and display of an approved document by a reader with appropriate authorization.

evts.name: generate_report
evts.description: Creation of an evaluation report filtered by role-specific parameters and selection criteria.

evts.name: update_valid_until_date
evts.description: Automatic recalculation and update of a document's validity expiration date based on validity extension period.

evts.name: apply_electronic_signature
evts.description: Electronic signing of a document by workflow participants with system documentation.

evts.name: document_acknowledgement_received
evts.description: Recording that a user has confirmed acknowledgement of a released document.

evts.name: retrieve_archived_document
evts.description: Access to an archived document by the archive group during the defined archive period.

o2o.description: A document may have one or more attachments that are controlled and released with the main document.
A document may have one or more additional information items that are released independently.
A change proposal is linked to and belongs to a specific document.
A document has multiple versions over its lifecycle.
A document may have translated language versions that must be released separately.
A document may reference other documents via its references attribute.
A document has a maintained distribution list specifying user groups and persons for notification.
An author is assigned to and responsible for authoring a document.
A co-author is assigned to a document with additional change rights.
Reviewers are assigned to a document to check its content during the review workflow step.
A releaser is assigned to a document and responsible for approving its release.
A translator is assigned to create and release translated versions of a document.
A reader accesses documents through inclusion in a distribution list user group or direct assignment.
User groups are assigned to distribution lists to grant read authorization and receive notifications.
A validity extension request is linked to the document requiring validity review.
An override request is linked to the document to be invalidated.
A reactivation request is linked to the document to be reactivated.
Guidelines may reference and implement policies at a more detailed organizational level.
Procedural instructions provide specific implementation details within the framework of guidelines.
Work instructions provide detailed steps for specific tasks within procedural instructions.
A document is created from a document template which provides standardized structure and metadata.
A document specifies its visibility across one or more client environments.
Archive group users retain read access to archived documents.
Attachments have their own versioning and may reference other attachments.
Electronic signatures are applied to documents during the release workflow and documented in the system.
An audit trail documents all changes and approvals for a document throughout its lifecycle.
A document maintains metadata attributes that can be updated and validated throughout its lifecycle.

o2e.description: A document is created as a new information object.
A document's content is modified during the editing phase.
A document's metadata and properties are created and updated.
Author authorization is assigned to enable document creation and editing.
Reviewer authorization is assigned to enable document review and approval.
Releaser authorization is assigned to enable document release approval.
Reader authorization is assigned via user group to enable document viewing.
User groups are assigned authorizations that apply to all members.
A document enters the workflow-supported release process.
The author applies an electronic signature in the first release workflow step.
Assigned reviewers check the document content and formally approve it.
Reviewers apply electronic signatures confirming approval during review.
The releaser approves and authorizes distribution of the document.
The releaser applies an electronic signature confirming approval for release.
A document is automatically published and made visible to addressed readers.
A document is automatically converted to PDF format after content saving.
A new version of a document is automatically created when specific conditions occur.
An attachment is marked for archiving when no longer relevant to a new document version.
A change proposal is created as a proposed amendment to a document.
An author submits a change proposal for an existing document.
A change proposal is scheduled for implementation creating a new document version.
A document's validity is extended when determined still valid.
A validity extension request is system-generated 30 days before a document expires.
A releaser processes the validity extension request through a workflow.
An author participates in processing a validity extension request.
A reviewer participates in processing a validity extension request.
A document is declared invalid and archived.
An override request is submitted to invalidate a document.
A releaser approves the override request to invalidate a document.
An author participates in processing an override request.
A reviewer participates in processing an override request.
A document is archived with authorizations revoked except for archive group.
A document is reactivated restoring its permissions and status.
A Business Admin user creates a reactivation request for an archived document.
Only the archive group can create reactivation requests.
Users in the distribution list receive email notifications on document release.
Users in the distribution list receive workflow requests for document acknowledgement.
A reader receives a request to confirm acknowledgement of a released document.
A reader confirms receipt and review of a distributed document.
A document language version is translated into another language.
A translator reviews the accuracy of a translated document version.
A translator approves the release of a translated document version.
An attachment object is attached to a main document.
Additional information is attached to a document.
A reader accesses and views an approved document.
An author generates role-specific evaluation reports on documents.
A reviewer generates role-specific evaluation reports on documents.
A releaser generates role-specific evaluation reports on documents.
A document's validity expiration date is recalculated and updated.
An electronic signature is applied by a workflow participant to a document.
Acknowledgement of document receipt is recorded for a reader.
An archive group member accesses an archived document for reference.
A new document is created by selecting a document template.
Metadata attributes are created and maintained for a document.
A document's file is converted to PDF format for web display.
